test_execution_summary.status: FAILED (SLA Violation on Compute Error Rate & Gateway P95)

bottlenecks_identified.issue: Synchronous blocking HTTP I/O inside asyncio event loop
bottlenecks_identified.root_cause: DynamicLocationStore._fetch_from_external_api uses synchronous requests.get() to OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Under concurrent load, requests blocks the entire single-threaded Python event loop.
bottlenecks_identified.impact: Event loop starvation, timeouts up to 92 seconds, and 97.7% failure rate.

bottlenecks_identified.issue: Public Nominatim API rate limiting (HTTP 429 / socket drops)
bottlenecks_identified.root_cause: Nominatim enforces a hard rate limit of 1 request/second. 500 concurrent agents querying un-cached locations causes immediate rate limiting and connection refusal.
bottlenecks_identified.impact: Cascade failure of DayPlannerAgent location lookups.

bottlenecks_identified.issue: Synchronous CPU spike during Bcrypt hashing and remote MongoDB Atlas roundtrips
bottlenecks_identified.root_cause: bcrypt.hash() with default cost factor 10 blocks the Node.js libuv thread pool. In addition, un-pooled individual Atlas cloud DB roundtrips add ~150-300ms network RTT per user transaction.
bottlenecks_identified.impact: Gateway acknowledgment p90 latency degraded to 14,200ms during the surge.

bottlenecks_identified.issue: Synchronous HTTP proxy coupling between Express and FastAPI
bottlenecks_identified.root_cause: Node.js route /api/chat/message holds an open HTTP connection to FastAPI for up to 30 seconds (AbortSignal.timeout(30000)) instead of utilizing an asynchronous message queue (e.g., Redis Streams / BullMQ) with WebSocket push.
bottlenecks_identified.impact: High socket accumulation, connection exhaustion, and increased memory footprint on the gateway.

recommendations.action: Replace synchronous 'requests' with 'httpx.AsyncClient' and offload CPU/blocking tasks to asyncio.to_thread or Celery/RQ workers.
Pre-seed Qdrant collections with top 50 global tourist destinations and implement a local Redis L1 cache before external Nominatim fallback.
Bifurcate chat messaging via Redis Streams or RabbitMQ. Acknowledge HTTP 200 to client within 20ms with sessionId, then stream itinerary tokens and state updates asynchronously over WebSocket.
Enable Mongoose maxPoolSize: 100, use lean() queries for LeadProfile reads, and deploy Redis caching for session authentication tokens.
